metadata.name: market_rips
metadata.description: Inventory-backed stock pack opening on Solana with MagicBlock

instructions.name: commit_pack_session
docs: Commits an intermediate reveal state from the ER back to Solana.

instructions.name: consume_pack_randomness
docs: MagicBlock VRF callback. The `#[vrf_callback]` account macro validates
the scoped VRF identity before this handler can run.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: delegate_pack_session
docs: Delegates only the per-purchase reveal state. Shared inventory, token
vaults, payments and settlement always remain on Solana L1.

accounts.name: buyer
docs: required because the refund destination is also constrained to this key.

instructions.name: request_pack_randomness
docs: Requests MagicBlock VRF on Solana L1. The callback also executes on L1,
where it can safely reserve shared stock inventory before the per-user
reveal session is delegated to an Ephemeral Rollup.

instructions.name: reveal_card
docs: Executes on the Ephemeral Rollup. A wallet may sign directly, or a
bounded SessionTokenV2 may authorize the temporary session signer.

instructions.name: undelegate_pack_session
docs: Final reveal step: commit state and return PackSession ownership to this
program on L1. Prize claims are valid only after this completes.
